notes: An unsealed draft (F19 plan v5 §5). The decision block is Q7 §13 and fixed. The lead developer drafts the simulation scenarios, the cross-check, the bootstrap and the secondary-outcome versions (Q7 §14.1 item 11); the operator approves them and draws the seeds. The cell ids are placeholders until §14.2 item 15; the cost-ratio ceiling is the operator's (§14.1 item 3) and the 1.0 here is a placeholder, as is the reconciliation fraction; the CF-B entries come from slice S16 (§14.1 item 4); the graded score is the task author's (§14.2 item 18). Scenarios: Q7 §13.3's null, ±10, ±15, ±20 and ±25 points and one heterogeneous vector with mean +20, on three raw baselines (the designer's dry run, and a floor and a ceiling vector), each chosen so that no treated probability leaves [0, 1]. At 10^6 draws and 2,000 replicates the 30 scenarios take about 8 CPU-hours; the rates' Monte Carlo error is at most ±1.1 points.

graded_score.definition: the task author's weighted fraction of hidden checks passed
